topic: Bosh miya travmatik shikastlanishining sud-gistologik diagnostikasi

slides.title: Kirish: bosh miya travmasi va sud-tibbiy ahamiyati

bullets.text: TBI — urilish, zarba, silkinish yoki kirib boruvchi jarohat tufayli miya odatdagi faoliyatining buzilishi (AQSh kasalliklar nazorati markazi ta’rifi).

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: TBI jarohatlar global yukiga katta hissa qo‘shadi; aholi o‘sishi bilan uning mutlaq soni yanada oshishi kutilmoqda.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: Kontuziya, qon quyilishi yoki yirtilish kabi makroskopik belgilar bo‘lmasa, TBIni o‘limning yagona yoki qo‘shimcha sababi deb belgilash qiyin.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: Diffuz aksonal shikastlanish (DAI) faqat mikroskopda ko‘rinsa, yetarli gistologik tekshiruvsiz tashxis qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama savollari: 1) Nega makroskopik belgilar bo‘lmaganda TBI tashxisi murakkablashadi? 2) Gistologiya bu holatda qanday rol o‘ynaydi? Doskada chizish: ikki ustunli sxema — «makroskopik belgilar bor» va «yo‘q» holatlari, har biriga tashxis usullarini yozing. Tipik xato: TBI va DAI tushunchalarini aralashtirish — DAI TBIning bir turi (diffuz aksonal komponenti), TBI esa kengroq tushuncha.

slides.title: TBIdan o‘lim sabablari tuzilishi

bullets.text: Og‘ir TBIda o‘lim bemorlarning taxminan to‘rtdan bir–uchdan bir qismida kuzatiladi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: Taxminan shuncha bemor og‘ir zarbadan keyin to‘liq tuzaladi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: Sud-tibbiy holatlar o‘z-o‘ziga urib shikastlashdan qotillik maqsadidagi zarbalargacha bo‘ladi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama savollari: 1) Nima uchun o‘z-o‘ziga zarar yetkazish birinchi o‘rinda turishi sud-tibbiy ekspertiza uchun muhim? 2) Jarohat mexanizmi tashxis yondashuviga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: uchta ulushni doiraviy diagrammada ko‘rsating, qolgan qismini «manbada ko‘rsatilmagan» deb belgilang. Tipik xato: uchta sababni jami 100% deb o‘ylash — manbada qolgan sabablar ko‘rsatilmagan.

slides.title: Kalla suyagi sinishlari turlari

bullets.text: Sinish joyi — yetkazilgan energiya suyakning deformatsiyalanish chegarasidan oshgan nuqta; u har doim zarba joyi bo‘lavermaydi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Chaqaloq kalla suyagi zarbadan sinmasdan ham sezilarli deformatsiyalanishi mumkin.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Bosh tepasiga zarba uzun chiziqli sinish beradi; ikki tomondan asosga o‘tib o‘rta chiziqda uchrashsa — og‘ir kuch belgisi bo‘lgan “hinge” sinish.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Balandlikdan boshga yoki oyoqqa tushishda katta teshik atrofida halqasimon sinish; keng yuzali zarbada “o‘rgimchak to‘ri” sinishi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Botiq sinishda ichki plastinka tashqisidan ko‘proq bo‘laklanadi; shakli qurol (masalan, bolg‘a) yuzasini takrorlashi mumkin.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Manba: Simpson, 9-bob, 99–100-betlar.

slides.title: Epidural va subdural qon quyilish

bullets.text: Epidural qon quyilish o‘rta meningeal arteriya shikastlanishi bilan bog‘liq (ko‘pincha chakka suyagi sinishi chizig‘i arteriyani kesganda).

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Arterial qon tez to‘planib, durani suyakdan ajratadi, gematoma miyani tez siljitadi va belgilar tez boshlanadi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Subdural qon quyilish ko‘prik venalar yirtilishidan; sinish bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi shart emas, aylanma yoki siljish kuchlari sabab.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Yangi subdural qon to‘q qizil va yaltiroq, bir necha kundan keyin qo‘ng‘ir tusga kiradi; Perls bo‘yashida gemosiderin ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Surunkali subdural gematoma yupqa “membrana”lar bilan o‘ralgan; keksalarda, alkogolga qaramlarda va tez-tez yiqiladiganlarda ko‘proq.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

columns.title: Subdural
items: Yosh va keksalarda anamnez bo‘lmasligi mumkin

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Manba: Simpson, 9-bob, 101–102-betlar.

slides.title: Koup va kontrkoup shikastlari

bullets.text: Koup — zarba joyidagi shikast; bosh terisi jarohati joyi odatda miya shikasti joyiga mos keladi (subaraxnoidal qon quyilish, po‘stloq kontuziyasi).

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Harakatdagi bosh (masalan, ensaga yiqilish) to‘satdan to‘xtaganda miya inersiya bilan harakatlanadi: zarbadan uzoqda kontrkoup kontuziyalar paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Kontrkoup ko‘pincha peshona va chakka bo‘laklarining pastki yuzasida uchraydi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Yerga tegib turgan, harakatsiz boshga zarba odatda kontrkoup bermaydi; peshonaga yiqilishda ensa bo‘lagida kontrkoup kamdan-kam.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Kontrkoup mexanizmi bahsli; qiyin holatda klinik-patologik taqqoslash va guvohlar ko‘rsatmasi zarur.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

columns.title: Koup
items: Teri jarohati va suyak sinishi ham bo‘lishi mumkin

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Manba: Simpson, 9-bob, 104–105-betlar.

slides.title: Miya shishi va ichki gerniya

bullets.text: Birlamchi shikastga javoban miya shishi (ikkilamchi shikast) rivojlanadi: suyuqlik hujayradan tashqari bo‘shliqqa o‘tadi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Kalla suyagi kengaya olmagani uchun bosim ortadi va miya meningeal burmalar atrofida siqiladi — ichki gerniya.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Tentorium orqali pastga siqilganda temporal bo‘lak ilgagi shikastlanadi va miya poyasiga bosim tushadi; katta teshik orqali — miyacha murtaklari (koning).

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

bullets.text: Shishgan miya og‘irlashadi, yuzasi yassilanadi; kesmada qorinchalar ingichka yoriqqa siqiladi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Manba: Simpson, 9-bob, 103-bet.

slides.title: Sud-tibbiy tashxis usullari xaritasi

bullets.text: β-amiloid prekursor oqsil (β-APP) immunogistokimyosi — DAI uchun oltin standart; mikroskopik shikast gistologiyasiz tashxislanmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Biokimyoviy belgilar mustaqil isbot emas, boshqa topilmalar bilan birga hisobga olinadi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

bullets.text: Bosh miya KT birinchi bosqich; MRT (magnit-rezonans tomografiya) mayda qon quyilishlarni aniqroq topadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama savollari: 1) Nima uchun qisqa yashagan holatda oddiy bo‘yash usullari yetarli emas? 2) β-APP musbat topilma nega travmaning yagona isboti bo‘lmaydi? Doskada chizish: vaqt o‘qi — 2–3 soat (β-APP), 12–18 soat (kumush), ~24 soat (gematoksilin-eozin). Tipik xato: β-APP ni travmaga mutlaqo xos deb hisoblash — u ishemiya/gipoksiyada ham ko‘rinadi. Qisqartma: KT — kompyuter tomografiya, MRT — magnit-rezonans tomografiya.

slides.title: Diffuz aksonal shikastlanish (DAI) tarixi

bullets.text: 1940-yillarda oq moddadagi diffuz o‘zgarishlarning tajriba modellari yozilgan; 1956-yilda Strich uni to‘liq tasvirlagan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Adams “diffuz aksonal shikastlanish” atamasini kiritgan va aksonal zararni uch bosqichli darajaga bo‘lgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Yuqori maydonli magnit-rezonans tomografiya (MRT) va immunobo‘yash DAI mexanizmlarini yoritishga yordam berdi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

items.title: Adams
items.text: Atama va aksonal zararning 3 bosqichli darajasi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega Strich ishi DAI tushunchasining poydevori hisoblanadi? 2) MRT va immunobo‘yash sud-gistologik tashxisni qanday o‘zgartirdi? Doskada: 1940-yillar–1956–Adams–MRT/immunobo‘yash vaqt chizig‘ini chizdiring. Tipik xato: Strich va Adams hissalarini aralashtirish (Strich tasvirlagan, Adams atamani kiritgan va darajalagan). TBI = travmatik bosh miya shikastlanishi.

slides.title: DAI jarohat mexanizmi

bullets.text: DAI aylanma tezlanish-sekinlanishli bosh miya jarohatining morfologik ekvivalenti; kesuvchi kuchlardan hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Miya inertsiyasi tufayli bosh tez harakatlanganda akson cho‘ziladi; eng ko‘p aylanma tezlanishda zararlanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Zarar zichligi turlicha to‘qimalar chegarasida (kul rang-oq modda) va rostral miya ustunida joylashadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega zarba kuchi bosh suyagi sinishiga yetmasa ham DAI bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) Koronal harakat sagittalga qaraganda nega og‘irroq zarar beradi (manbada shunday deyilgan)? Doskada: bosh harakati yo‘nalishlari va zarar joylarini sxema qilib chizdiring. Tipik xato: DAI faqat bosh suyagi sinishi bilan keladi deb o‘ylash. Diqqat: kesuvchi kuch ≠ siquvchi kuch.

slides.title: Tajriba modellari: FP, CCI, CHIMERA

bullets.text: Inson miyasi murakkab, shuning uchun DAIdagi barcha dinamik kuchlarni tajribada to‘liq qayta yaratish qiyin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: FP (suyuqlik zarbasi) va CCI (nazoratli kortikal zarba) da kuch ochilgan qattiq pardaga beriladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Yopiq modellar zarba, portlash yoki bosh aylanishiga asoslanadi; CHIMERA da bosh zarbadan so‘ng erkin harakatlanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega ochiq modellar DAI mexanizmini to‘liq aks ettirmasligi mumkin? 2) CHIMERA qanday afzallik beradi (biokimyoviy, xulq-atvor va neyropatologik tahlil birga)? Doskada: ochiq va yopiq model farqini ikki ustunli sxema qilib chizdiring. Tipik xato: FP/CCI ni yopiq model deb adashtirish. Diqqat: ochiq model ≠ yopiq model. CHIMERA = yopiq bosh, aylanma tezlanish muhandislik modeli.

slides.title: Zarba yo‘nalishi va real hayotdagi holatlar

bullets.text: Bosh harakatining yo‘nalishi muhim: koronal (yon tomonga) harakat sagittal (oldinga-orqaga) harakatga qaraganda og‘irroq diffuz shikast bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Tajribada tezlanish-sekinlashish kuchlari shikast uchun yetarli. Real hayotda esa deyarli doim avval to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri zarba bo‘ladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Subdural gematoma qattiq yuzaga yiqilishda ko‘proq uchraydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diffuz aksonal shikast (DAI) transport yo‘lovchilarida uchraydi: yumshoq yuza sekinlashishni cho‘zadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: DAI uchun dastlabki zarba kuchi bosh suyagini sindirishga yetmasligi mumkin, shunda ham diffuz miya shikasti paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4-5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega transport hodisasida DAI, qattiq yuzaga yiqilishda esa subdural gematoma ko‘proq uchraydi? 2) Bosh suyagi sinmasa, DAI ehtimolini qanday baholaymiz? Doskada chizish: bosh va bo‘yinning koronal hamda sagittal harakat sxemasi, har biriga strelka bilan. Tipik xato: bosh suyagi sinmagan bo‘lsa, og‘ir diffuz shikast yo‘q deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: DAI mexanizmi

bullets.text: Vaziyat: transport hodisasi qurboni. Bosh suyagi sinmagan, kompyuter tomografiyasida (KT) aniq intrakranial shikast ko‘rinmaydi, ong yo‘qotilgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ma’lumot: DAI KTda shikast ko‘rinmasa ham travmadan keyingi ong yo‘qolishining asosiy sabablaridan biri hisoblanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Yumshoq yuzaga zarba sekinlashishni cho‘zadi, shu sababli suyak sinmasa ham diffuz shikast rivojlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: DAI ehtimoli bormi va uni qanday tasdiqlaymiz? Aksonal shikast faqat mikroskopda ko‘rinadi, gistologiyasiz tashxis qo‘yilmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Vaziyat o‘quv maqsadida manba ma’lumotlaridan tuzilgan. Muhokama: 1) KT normal bo‘lsa, DAI istisno etiladimi? 2) Sud-tibbiy ekspert qaysi tekshiruvni tanlaydi? Doskada chizish: mexanizm zanjiri (transport hodisasi - bosh harakati - aksonlarga siljish kuchi - ong yo‘qolishi). Tipik xato: KTda o‘zgarish yo‘q bo‘lsa, DAI yo‘q deb xulosa qilish.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: mexanizm va tarix

bullets.text: Savol 1: DAI qanday shikastning morfologik korrelyati? Javob: rotatsion tezlanish-sekinlashishli bosh miya jarohati (cho‘zilish va siljish kuchlari).

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol 2: og‘ir travmatik bosh miya jarohati (TBI) dan keyin oq moddaning gistopatologik ko‘rinishini 1956-yilda birinchi to‘liq tasvirlagan kim? Javob: Strich.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol 3: «diffuz aksonal shikast» atamasini kim kiritgan? Javob: Adams. U DAIni aksonal shikast darajasiga ko‘ra uch bosqichli tizimga ajratgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Talabalar savollarga avval yozma javob beradi, keyin javoblar tekshiriladi. Muhokama: Strich va Adams hissasi qanday farq qiladi (tasvirlash va atama hamda baholash tizimi)? Doskada chizish: sodda vaqt chizig‘i (1940-yillar tajribalar, 1956 Strich, keyin Adams). Tipik xato: Strich va Adams hissasini aralashtirish.

slides.title: Birlamchi va ikkilamchi aksotomiya

bullets.text: DAI (diffuz aksonal shikast) faqat zarbadagi mexanik uzilishdan emas, ikkilamchi aksotomiyadan ham kelib chiqadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ikkilamchi uzilish — shikastdan keyin akson ichida davom etadigan molekulyar va hujayraviy o‘zgarishlar kaskadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: birlamchi aksotomiya ≠ ikkilamchi aksotomiya. Biri zarba paytida, ikkinchisi keyinroq yuz beradi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun zarba paytida uzilmagan akson keyinroq uzilishi mumkin? 2) Bu holat sud-gistologik tashxisda qanday ahamiyatga ega? Doskada chizish: ikki shoxli sxema — chapda birlamchi (zarba paytida), o‘ngda ikkilamchi (kaskad orqali). Tipik xato: talabalar DAI ni faqat zarbaning bevosita mexanik oqibati deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: Aksonal transport buzilishi va β-APP to‘planishi

bullets.text: Aksonlar viskoelastik bo‘lgani uchun travmadagi yuqori deformatsiya tezligida oson shikastlanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: β-APP (β-amiloid prekursor oqsil) shikastdan 2 soat ichida aksonda aniqlanishi mumkin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: β-APP to‘planishi boshqa holatlarda ham uchraydi, faqat travmaga xos emas.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun transport buzilsa akson shishadi? 2) β-APP ni topish nima uchun yagona dalil bo‘la olmaydi? Doskada chizish: akson sxemasi — shishgan joy va uzilgan uchi bilan. Tipik xato: β-APP musbat natijani avtomatik travmatik DAI deb xulosa qilish.

slides.title: Kalsiy gomeostazi, kaspaza va kalpain

bullets.text: Glutamat va boshqa qo‘zg‘atuvchi aminokislotalar ajralishi hamda neyron membranasining mexanoporatsiyasi kalsiy gomeostazini buzadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Kalsiy kaspaza va kalpain fermentlarini faollashtiradi; ular nekroz va apoptozning boshlanishida rol o‘ynaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Erkin radikallar hosil bo‘lishi va lizosomalardan gidrolitik fermentlar chiqishi sitotoksik kaskadni kuchaytiradi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Kalsiy kanali blokatori nimodipin ikkilamchi shikastni kamaytirishi mumkin; bu yondashuv terapevtik nishon sifatida ko‘riladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 9 daq. Muhokama: 1) Mexanoporatsiya nima va u kalsiyga qanday ta’sir qiladi? 2) Nimodipin qaysi bosqichga ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: glutamat → kalsiy ↑ → kaspaza/kalpain → nekroz/apoptoz zanjiri. Tipik xato: kaspaza va kalpainni aralashtirish; ikkalasi ham kalsiyga bog‘liq fermentlar ekanini eslatib o‘ting.

slides.title: Neyrovospalenie: mikroglia va sitokinlar

bullets.text: Mikroglia markaziy asab tizimining immun hujayralari. Diffuz aksonal shikastlanish (DAI) modellarida ularning javobi ko‘p o‘rganilgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Galectin-3/Mac-2 miyelin parchalanishida qatnashuvchi faollashgan mikroglia qismining belgisi sifatida qo‘llangan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: β-APP (β-amiloid prekursor oqsil) aksonal o‘zgarishni, CD68 mikroglia infiltratsiyasini ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Bemorlarning yarmida ular jarohatdan 5–15 kun o‘tgach birga joylashgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Yallig‘lanishda sitokinlar IL-1α, IL-1β, IL-6 (interleykin), TNF-α (o‘sma nekrozi omili), shuningdek ICAM-1 va xemokin MCP-1 qatnashadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) β-APP va CD68 birga bo‘yalishi gistologik nimani isbotlaydi? 2) Nega bu 5–15 kunlik omon qolish muddatida muhim? Doskada: aksonal shikast → mikroglia → sitokinlar zanjirini chizdiring. Tipik xato: β-APP to‘planishini faqat travmaga xos deb hisoblash; manbada bu to‘planish boshqa holatlarda ham uchrashi aytilgan (β-APP ≠ travmaning yagona belgisi).

slides.title: Oksidlovchi stress va mitoxondriya roli

bullets.text: Mitoxondriya kislorodni ko‘p sarflaydi; elektronlar kislorodga o‘tib, superoksid (O2−) hosil qiladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: ROS (reaktiv kislorod turlari) hosil bo‘lishi va yo‘qotilishi muvozanati buzilsa — oksidlovchi stress.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Mitoxondriya shikastlansa himoya kamayadi, ROS uni yana buzadi: yomon doira (o‘ta aylanma zanjir).

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Sog‘lom mitoxondriyada ROS nega kam hosil bo‘ladi? 2) Yomon doira qaysi bosqichda uzilishi mumkin? Doskada: diagrammadagi zanjirni yopiq doira shaklida chizdiring. Antioksidant tizim: tokoferol, koenzim Q10, glutation (GSH) va fermentlar (superoksid dismutaza, katalaza). Tipik xato: ROS ni faqat zararli deb o‘ylash; muammo muvozanat buzilishida.

slides.title: mPTP va kalpain-1 musbat teskari aloqa sikli

bullets.text: mPTP (mitoxondrial o‘tkazuvchanlik pori) Ca2+ yig‘ilishidan hosil bo‘ladi, kichik molekulalarni o‘tkazadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Oksidlovchi stress Ca2+ ni chiqaradi; kalpain-1 faollashib, Ca2+ kirishini yana oshiradi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: AIF (apoptozni qo‘zg‘ovchi omil) va kaspaza-3 birga DNK fragmentatsiyasi va apoptozni qo‘zg‘atadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Musbat teskari aloqa nima uchun jarayonni kuchaytiradi? 2) Kalpain-1 kaspaza-3 ni ham faollashtirishini qanday tushuntirasiz? Doskada: Ca2+ → kalpain-1 → Ca2+ ↑ sikl strelkalarini chizdiring. Qo‘shimcha: siklosporin A mPTP ni ingibirlaydi, lekin natijalar qat’iy emas. Tipik xato: kalpain va kaspazani bir xil ferment deb adashtirish; kalpain — kalsiyga bog‘liq sistein proteaza.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: ikkilamchi shikastlanish

bullets.text: Vaziyat: avtohalokatda jabrlanuvchi hushini yo‘qotgan, lekin kompyuter tomografiyada (KT) ko‘rinadigan intrakranial shikast yo‘q.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Aksotomiya faqat zarbaning o‘zidan (birlamchi) emas, zarbadan keyingi molekulyar va hujayraviy zanjirdan ham (ikkilamchi) kelib chiqadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Glutamat ajralishi va membrananing mexanik shikasti kalsiy gomeostazini buzadi; kalpain va kaspazalar faollashib, nekroz hamda apoptozni boshlaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: tirik qolgan jabrlanuvchida neyronlar zarbadan keyin ham nega nobud bo‘lishda davom etadi? Zanjirni bosqichma-bosqich sanang.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) KT da o‘choq bo‘lmasa, hush yo‘qolishining sababi nima bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) Birlamchi va ikkilamchi aksotomiya farqi nimada? Doskada: zarba → Ca2+ ortishi → kalpain/kaspaza → neyron o‘limi zanjirini chizdiring. Tipik xato: talabalar neyron o‘limini faqat zarbaning bevosita natijasi deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: patofiziologiya

bullets.text: Savol: aksonda hujayra ichi kalsiy ortsa, mitoxondriyada nima hosil bo‘ladi va u qanday stressga olib keladi?

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Javob: ortiqcha Ca2+ mitoxondriyaga o‘tadi, reaktiv kislorod turlari (ROS) hosil bo‘ladi va oksidlovchi stress rivojlanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Faollashgan kalpain-1 qo‘shimcha Ca2+ kirishini ta’minlaydi va musbat teskari aloqa halqasini hosil qiladi; kaspaza-3 ham faollashadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi! ROS orqali aksonal o‘zgarishda hujayra tashqi Ca2+ asosiy, mitoxondrial o‘tkazuvchanlik teshigi (mPTP) ikkilamchi rol o‘ynaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Talabalardan avval javob so‘rang, keyin slaydni oching. Muhokama: nega tashqi Ca2+ ni olib tashlash mitoxondrial Ca2+ ajralishini to‘sishdan samaraliroq? Doskada: kalpain-1 va Ca2+ kirishi o‘rtasidagi halqani strelkalar bilan chizdiring. Tipik xato: mPTP ni asosiy sabab deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Makroskopik belgilar: Adams bo‘yicha uch belgi

bullets.text: Adams 45 ta o‘lim holatida diffuz aksonal shikastning (DAI) uch tuzilma belgisini ta’riflagan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Fokal o‘choqlar qisqa yashaganlarda gemorragik; keyinchalik gemosiderin tufayli jigarrang chandiqqa aylanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Aksonal shikastni faqat mikroskopda ko‘rish mumkin; yetarli gistologiyasiz DAI tashxisi qo‘yilmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

items.title: II daraja
items.text: Kallosum fokal o‘chog‘i; pastki qism, o‘rta chiziqdan yonda

items.title: III daraja
items.text: Rostral miya ustuni o‘chog‘i; dorsolateral kvadrant, yuqori oyoqcha yoni

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega aksonal shikast makroskopik ko‘rinmasligi mumkin? 2) Kallosum o‘chog‘i o‘rta chiziqqa yetsa nima kuzatiladi? (qorinchalararo to‘siq uzilishi, qorincha ichi qon quyilishi). Doskada: kallosum va rostral miya ustunining sagittal sxemasini chizib, o‘choqlarni belgilang. Tipik xato: Adams darajalarini mikroskopik Gennarelli darajalari bilan aralashtirish.

slides.title: O‘choqlar joylashuvi va vaqt davomida o‘zgarishi

bullets.text: Og‘ir DAI da uch belgi bor: oq moddada diffuz shikast, kallazsimon tanada o‘choq va rostral miya sopida o‘choq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Gemorragik o‘choq qisqa yashaganlarda qonli bo‘ladi. Keyin kichrayib chandiqqa aylanadi va autopsiyada topish qiyinlashadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Gemosiderin tufayli jigarrang ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Kallazsimon tanadagi o‘choq pastki qismda, o‘rta chiziqdan bir yonda turadi. Chiziqqa yetsa, qorinchalar to‘sig‘i uzilib, qorincha ichiga qon quyiladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Bir necha oy yashaganda oq modda hajmi kamayib, qorinchalar kengayadi. Autopsiyada buni travmadan keyingi gidrosefaliya bilan adashtirish mumkin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega qisqa yashaganlarda o‘choq qonli, uzoq yashaganlarda esa jigarrang chandiq bo‘ladi? 2) Oq modda hajmi kamayganda qorinchalar kengayishi nega gidrosefaliyaga o‘xshab ketadi? Doskada chizing: miya kesimida kallazsimon tana, o‘rta chiziq va rostral miya sopining dorsolateral kvadranti (yuqori serebellyar oyoqcha yonida). Tipik xato: o‘choq bor-yo‘qligiga qarab tashxis qo‘yish. Manbaga ko‘ra aksonal shikast faqat mikroskopda ko‘rinadigan holatlar ham bo‘ladi.

slides.title: Mikroskopik diagnostik mezonlar

bullets.text: DAI tashxisi shikastlangan aksonlarning mikroskopik topilmasi bilan tasdiqlanadi: shishgan aksonal varikozitlar va aksonal bulblar.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ikki asosiy belgi: oq moddada diffuz yoki multifokal aksonal shikast va uning ko‘p miya hududlarida tarqalganligi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Hududlardan kamida biri tentoriumdan yuqorida, biri pastda bo‘lishi kerak.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Aksonal shikast faqat mikroskopda ko‘rinadigan hollarda adekvat gistologik tekshiruvsiz DAI tashxisini qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Hill va hamkasblariga ko‘ra “retraksiya bulbi” atamasi to‘liq emas: shakl aksonal transport buzilishi bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega kamida bitta hudud tentoriumdan yuqorida va bittasi pastda bo‘lishi talab qilinadi? 2) “Retraksiya bulbi” o‘rniga “aksonal bulb” atamasi qanday patogenetik g‘oyani aks ettiradi? Doskada chizing: tentorium chizig‘i va uning ikki tomonidagi hududlarni belgilang, aksonal bulb sxemasini qo‘shing. Tipik xato: bitta hududdagi aksonal shishni diffuz DAI deb baholash; “Diqqat: bulb ≠ faqat retraksiya, mexanizm transport buzilishi”. Katta yagona shishni “aksonal bulb” deb atash taklif etilgan.

slides.title: Gennarelli bo‘yicha DAI darajalari

bullets.text: Gennarelli primatlardagi tajribalarda aksonal shikastni og‘irligi bo‘yicha uch darajaga ajratgan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Aksonal shikast miqdori va tarqalishi koma davomiyligi, og‘irligi va yakuniy oqibat bilan yaxshi bog‘liq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: 1-darajada o‘choq yo‘q; 2-darajada kallazsimon tana, 3-darajada miya ustuni ham qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega daraja ortishi bilan koma og‘irligi va oqibat bog‘lanadi? 2) Qaysi hududda o‘choq topilsa, 2-daraja 3-darajaga o‘tadi? Doskada chizing: uch ustunli jadvalni talabalar bilan birga to‘ldiring. Tipik xato: Gennarelli darajalarini (1–3) Adams bo‘yicha strukturaviy belgilar (I–III) bilan aralashtirish va o‘choqning qaysi qismda ekanligini unutish.

slides.title: Omon qolish muddati va gistologik manzara

bullets.text: Aksonal zarar omon qolish muddatiga qarab uch xil ko‘rinishda bo‘ladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Aksonal zararning miqdori va tarqalishi koma davomiyligi hamda oqibat bilan yaxshi mos keladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

Doskada: kunlar, haftalar va oylar uchun vaqt chizig‘ini chizib, har biriga gistologik belgini yozing. slides.title: Bo‘yash usullari va aniqlash vaqt oynasi

bullets.text: Qisqa omon qolganda oddiy bo‘yashlar bilan diffuz aksonal jarohat (DAI) ni topish qiyin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: DAI uchun immunogistokimyoning oltin standarti — β-APP (β-amiloid prekursor oqsil) qidiruvi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Odatda tinktorial bo‘yashlar — gematoksilin-eozin va kumush impregnatsiyasi — ishlatib kelingan.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Jarohatdan 3 soat o‘tib o‘lgan jasadda qaysi usul tanlanadi va nega? 2) Gematoksilin-eozin manfiy bo‘lsa, DAI inkor etiladimi? Doskada: soat o‘qini chizib, 2–3, 12–18 va 24 soat nuqtalariga usullarni joylang. Tipik xato: kumush impregnatsiyasi (12–18 soat) bilan gematoksilin-eozin (taxminan 24 soat) vaqtini almashtirib yuborish. Eslab qoling: usul qanchalik zamonaviy bo‘lsa, shunchalik erta aniqlaydi.

slides.title: Diqqat: β-APP travmaga xos emas

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi! β-APP ifodasi aksonal jarohat belgisi, lekin travmani ishemiya yoki gipoksiyadan ajratib bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Shu sababli DAI faqat mexanik jarohatga xos belgi deb hisoblanmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Niess 450 ta tanlanmagan miyani β-APP bilan tekshirdi: travmada zarar asosan ko‘prikda, zaharlanishda ko‘prik va katta miyada keng.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Hayashi kallosumda β-APP bilan bo‘yalgan aksonal bulbalar naqshini travma va gipoksiyada solishtirib, ikki xil naqsh topdi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) β-APP musbat bo‘lsa, ekspert xulosasida nimani qo‘shimcha hisobga olish kerak? 2) Zaharlanish va travmada zararning joylashuvi nima bilan farq qiladi? Doskada: ko‘prik va katta miya uchun ikki ustunli taqqoslash sxemasini chizing (travma va zaharlanish). Tipik xato: β-APP musbat natijani avtomatik ravishda travmatik DAI deb xulosalash.

bullets.text: Vaziyat: bosh jarohatidan keyin taxminan 3 soat o‘tib o‘lim yuz berdi. Gistolog oddiy bo‘yash va β-APP bo‘yicha immunogistokimyoni qo‘llaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Gematoksilin-eozin aksonal shikastni taxminan 24 soatdan keyin, kumush impregnatsiyasi esa 12–18 soatdan keyin ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: β-APP (amiloid prekursor oqsil) ga qarshi antitanalar shikastlangan aksonlarni jarohatdan 2–3 soat o‘tib aniqlashga imkon beradi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: nega bu holatda oddiy bo‘yash manfiy, β-APP esa musbat bo‘lishi mumkin? Diqqat: β-APP travma bilan ishemiya/gipoksiyani ajratmaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: (1) Nega qisqa omon qolishda gematoksilin-eozin ishonchsiz? (2) β-APP musbat bo‘lsa, travmani ishemiyadan ajratish uchun yana nima kerak? Doskada chizing: 0–24 soat vaqt chizig‘i va unda 2–3 soat (β-APP), 12–18 soat (kumush), ~24 soat (gematoksilin-eozin) belgilari. Tipik xato: β-APP musbat natijani avtomatik ‘sof mexanik travma’ deb talqin qilish.

bullets.text: 1-savol: qaysi usul aksonal shikastni eng erta, 2–3 soatdan keyin ko‘rsatadi? Javob: β-APP immunogistokimyosi; kumush va gematoksilin-eozin kechroq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: 2-savol: Adams bo‘yicha I daraja – diffuz supratentorial aksonal shikast; II – jismoniy tanadagi o‘choq; III – rostral miya poyasidagi o‘choq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: 3-savol: Gennarelli bo‘yicha 1-darajada oq moddada tarqoq retraksiya sharlari; 2-darajada kallozal o‘choq; 3-darajada miya poyasi o‘chog‘i qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

Doskada chizing: ikki ustunli jadval – daraja va o‘choq joyi (Adams / Gennarelli). Tipik xato: o‘choq darajalarini aksonal shikast darajasi bilan aralashtirish va gistologik tekshiruvsiz DAI tashxisini qo‘yish.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: nega yuqori spetsifiklik bilan sezgirlik past bo‘lishi mumkin? Chegaralar boshqa laboratoriyada qo‘llanadimi? Doskada: 4 markerli jadvalni ko‘chiring va ferritin, BDNF, NGAL, LDH qatorlarini qo‘shing. Qo‘shimcha: GFAP likvorda 385.5 ng/ml chegarada sezgirlik 71.1%, spetsifiklik 71.4%; diffuz gipoksiyada GFAP yuqori chiqishi mumkin. Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi – aniqlik (accuracy) ≠ spetsifiklik; hech bir marker TBI uchun 100% spetsifik emas, natija boshqa dalillar bilan birga baholanadi. Tipik xato: chegarani mustaqil isbot deb hisoblash.

Doskada chizish: mexanizm zanjirini yozing: kuch, aksonal shikast, Ca2+ va ROS, aksonal bulba, gistologik tashxis. Tipik xato: biomarker chegaraviy qiymatini mutlaq tashxis mezoni deb qabul qilish. Biomarkerlar (S100B, NSE, GFAP va boshqalar) faqat qo‘shimcha dalil. Ular o‘lim sababini mustaqil isbotlamaydi, avtopsiya va gistologiya bilan birga baholanadi.

mcq.question: Murdada bosh zarbasining makroskopik belgilari (ko‘karish, qon quyilish, yirtilgan jarohat) yo‘q, o‘lim holatlari noma’lum. Ekspert uchun asosiy qiyinchilik nima?
options: O‘lim vaqtini faqat gistologiya yordamida aniqlash majburiy bo‘lib qoladi
Qon aylanishi to‘xtagani uchun miya to‘qimasini tekshirib bo‘lmaydi
Travmatik bosh miya shikastini o‘lim sababi deb belgilash qiyinlashadi
Boshqa o‘lim sabablarini rasmiy ravishda istisno qilish imkoni bo‘lmaydi
mcq.explanation: Mualliflarga ko‘ra, travmatik bosh miya shikastlanishi (TBI) belgilari (ko‘karish, qon quyilish, yirtilish) ko‘rinmasa, uni yagona yoki hissa qo‘shgan o‘lim sababi deb aniqlash qiyin. Shu sababli obyektiv tasdiq beruvchi postmortem biokimyoviy tahlillar ko‘rib chiqilmoqda.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

mcq.question: TBIga bog‘liq o‘limlarning eng katta ulushi qaysi sababga to‘g‘ri keladi?
options: Qasddan o‘ziga zarar yetkazish
Tasodifiy yiqilib tushish
Avtotransport hodisasi
Boshqa kishining zarbasi
mcq.explanation: Manbada TBIga bog‘liq o‘lim ko‘pincha qasddan o‘ziga zarar yetkazishdan (33%) kelib chiqishi aytilgan. Undan keyin tasodifiy yiqilish (28%) va avtotransport hodisalari (19%) turadi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

mcq.question: Jabrlanuvchi bosh jarohatidan so‘ng taxminan 3 soat yashab vafot etdi. Qaysi usul shikastlangan aksonlarni shu erta muddatda aniqlashi mumkin?
options: Gematoksilin-eozin bilan oddiy bo‘yash usuli
Kumush bilan impregnatsiya qilish usuli
Faqat makroskopik ko‘rik va tortish usuli
β-amiloid prekursor oqsil (β-APP) immunogistokimyosi
mcq.explanation: Gematoksilin-eozin aksonal shikastni taxminan 24 soatdan keyin, kumush impregnatsiyasi 12–18 soatdan keyin ko‘rsatadi. β-APPga qarshi antitanalar esa shikastlangan aksonlarni jarohatdan 2–3 soat o‘tib aniqlashga imkon beradi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Avtohalokatda boshning tez burilishi kuzatilgan, bosh suyagi sinmagan, kompyuter tomografiyada (KT) ichki shikast ko‘rinmaydi, ammo ong uzoq yo‘qolgan. Qaysi mexanizm ehtimol?
options: Bosh suyagi sinishidan keyin paydo bo‘lgan epidural gematoma
Miyaning bir nuqtada to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ezilishi
Miya qon tomirining o‘z-o‘zidan yorilishi sababli qon quyilishi
Aylanma tezlanish-sekinlanishdan yuzaga kelgan kesuvchi kuchlar
mcq.explanation: Diffuz aksonal shikastlanish (DAI) KTda ko‘rinadigan intrakranial o‘zgarishlarsiz ong yo‘qolishining asosiy sabablaridan biri hisoblanadi. U aylanma tezlanish-sekinlanish va kesuvchi kuchlarning morfologik natijasidir. Zarba kuchi bosh suyagini sindirishga yetmasligi ham mumkin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchi butun bosh suyagiga aniq energiyali zarba berib, zarbadan keyin bosh harakatini cheklamaslikni xohlaydi. Qaysi model mos keladi?
options: Suyuqlik zarbasi (FP) modeli
Boshqariladigan kortikal zarba (CCI) modeli
CHIMERA modeli
Portlash to‘lqinli yopiq model
mcq.explanation: FP va CCI ochiq bosh modellari bo‘lib, kuch kraniotomiyadan so‘ng ochilgan qattiq parda (dura mater)ga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri beriladi. CHIMERA modelida yopiq bosh suyagiga aniq energiyali zarba beriladi va zarbadan keyin bosh erkin harakatlanadi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Avtohalokatda bosh tez aylanma tezlanish-sekinlashishga uchradi, bosh suyagi butun, KT da intrakranial o‘zgarish yo‘q, lekin ong yo‘qolgan. Bu holatning eng ehtimoliy morfologik asosi qaysi?
options: Epidural gematoma hosil qilgan bosim ta’siri
Diffuz aksonal shikastlanish (DAI) holati
Bosh suyagi sinig‘i hosil qilgan ezilish
Gipertenziv qon quyilishning ta’siri
mcq.explanation: DAI aylanma tezlanish-sekinlashishli bosh miya travmasining morfologik korrelyati hisoblanadi. U KT da ko‘rinadigan intrakranial o‘zgarishlarsiz ong yo‘qolishining asosiy sabablaridan biri deb qaraladi. Zarba kuchi bosh suyagini sindirishga yetmasligi ham mumkin.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Ikkilamchi aksotomiya qaysi jarayon natijasida rivojlanadi?
options: Zarba paytidagi bevosita mexanik uzilishning o‘zidan
Qon ketishdan hosil bo‘lgan gematoma bosimidan
Bosh suyagi sinig‘i bilan bog‘liq bevosita ezilishdan
Dastlabki kesish stressidan keyingi ketma-ket molekulyar kaskaddan
mcq.explanation: DAI faqat birlamchi aksotomiya (mexanik kuchdan) bilan emas, balki dastlabki kesish stressidan keyin aksonda boshlanadigan progressiv molekulyar va hujayraviy o‘zgarishlar kaskadidan kelib chiqqan ikkilamchi aksotomiya bilan ham bog‘liq. A variant birlamchi aksotomiyani ta’riflaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Epidural qon quyilish qaysi tomir shikastlanishi bilan bog‘liq?
options: O‘rta meningeal arteriya
Ko‘prik (bridging) venalar
Vertebral arteriya
Chuqur miya venalari
mcq.explanation: Epidural qon quyilish meningeal arteriya, ayniqsa chakka suyagidagi o‘rta meningeal arteriya shikastidan; arterial qon tez to‘planib durani suyakdan ajratadi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

mcq.question: Eksperimentda ROS vositasidagi aksonal sferoidlar hosil bo‘lishini kamaytirish uchun qaysi strategiya samaraliroq deb ko‘rsatilgan?
options: Mitoxondriyadan kalsiy chiqishini bloklash usuli
Hujayra ichidagi kalsiy zahirasini ko‘paytirish usuli
Hujayra tashqarisidagi kalsiyni olib tashlash usuli
Glutamat ajralishini kuchaytirish usuli
mcq.explanation: ROS vositasidagi aksonal o‘zgarishlar asosan hujayradan tashqaridagi Ca2+ tufayli yuzaga keladi. Hujayra ichidagi kalsiyni kamaytirish va sferoid hosil bo‘lishini to‘xtatishda tashqi Ca2+ ni olib tashlash mitoxondriyal Ca2+ chiqishini bloklashdan samaraliroq.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Birlamchi neyronlarda oksidlovchi stress kalsiy ajralishini chaqirdi va kalpain-1 faollashdi. Faollashgan kalpain-1 kalsiy bilan bog‘liq siklni qanday o‘zgartiradi?
options: Kalsiy kirishini to‘xtatib, mPTP ni yopib qo‘yadi
Qo‘shimcha Ca2+ kirishini kuchaytirib, musbat teskari aloqa hosil qiladi
Antioksidant glutation zahirasini to‘ldirib, stressni kamaytiradi
AIF ni mitoxondriya ichida ushlab, apoptozni to‘xtatadi
mcq.explanation: Faollashgan kalpain-1 qo‘shimcha Ca2+ kirishiga vositachilik qilib musbat teskari aloqa siklini hosil qiladi. Shuningdek mPTP ni induksiya qiladi, AIF ni mitoxondriyadan chiqaradi va kaspaza-3 ni faollashtiradi. Bular birgalikda DNK fragmentatsiyasi va apoptozga olib keladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Autopsiyada diffuz aksonal shikast, korpus kallozumda o‘choq va rostral miya poyasining dorsolateral kvadrantida o‘choq topildi. Adams bo‘yicha bu qaysi daraja?
options: I daraja: faqat diffuz aksonal shikast bor
II daraja: korpus kallozum o‘chog‘i bilan
III daraja: miya poyasi o‘chog‘i bilan
Daraja qo‘yilmaydi: gistologiya shart emas
mcq.explanation: Adams bo‘yicha I daraja diffuz supratentorial aksonal shikastni, II daraja korpus kallozumdagi o‘choqni, III daraja rostral miya poyasidagi o‘choqni bildiradi. Savoldagi uchala belgi birga bo‘lsa, eng og‘ir shakl, ya’ni III daraja qo‘yiladi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Ensaga yiqilganda kontrkoup kontuziyalar ko‘pincha qayerda uchraydi?
options: Peshona va chakka bo‘laklarining pastki yuzasida
Zarba joyi — ensa po‘stlog‘ida
Miyacha yarim sharlarida
Ko‘prikning old yuzasida
mcq.explanation: Harakatdagi bosh ensaga urilganda kontrkoup kontuziyalar ko‘pincha peshona va chakka bo‘laklarining pastki yuzasida paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Payne-James J., Jones R., Karch S.B., Manlove J.
source.title: Simpson's Forensic Medicine, 13th ed.

mcq.question: Gistologik preparatda butun oq modda bo‘ylab mikrogliyaning kichik klasterlari ko‘rinadi. Bu manzara qaysi omon qolish muddatiga xos?
options: Qisqa muddat: bir necha kun ichida o‘lim
O‘rta muddat: bir necha hafta omon qolish
Uzoq muddat: ko‘p oylar omon qolish
Bir necha soniya ichida bo‘lgan o‘lim
mcq.explanation: Qisqa muddatda (kunlar) oq moddada ko‘plab aksonal shishlar bo‘ladi. O‘rta muddatda (haftalar) mikrogliyaning kichik klasterlari paydo bo‘ladi. Ko‘p oylar omon qolganda Uoller tipidagi degeneratsiya xarakterlidir.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Ekspert DAI tashxisini mikroskopik tasdiqlamoqchi. Shikastlangan aksonlarning tarqalishi bo‘yicha qaysi talab bajarilishi shart?
options: Faqat korpus kallozumda shikast bo‘lishi yetarli
Faqat miya yarim sharlarida shikast bo‘lishi yetarli
Faqat miya poyasida shikast bo‘lishi yetarli
Kamida bittasi tentorium ustida, bittasi ostida bo‘lishi
mcq.explanation: DAI tashxisining ikki asosiy belgisi bor: oq moddada diffuz yoki ko‘p o‘choqli aksonal shikast va uning keng tarqalganligi. Shikast o‘choqlaridan kamida bittasi tentorium ustida, kamida bittasi uning ostida joylashishi kerak.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Preparatda corpus callosumda β-APP musbat aksonal bulbalar topildi. Faqat shu natijaga tayanib nimani ishonchli ajratib bo‘lmaydi?
options: Aksonal shikast borligini ajratib bo‘lmaydi
Aksonal shikastning kelib chiqish sababini ajratib bo‘lmaydi
Shikast oq moddada ekanini ajratib bo‘lmaydi
Aksonlarda transport buzilganini ajratib bo‘lmaydi
mcq.explanation: β-APP aksonal shikast belgisi, lekin travmatik shikastni ishemiya yoki gipoksiyadan farqlay olmaydi. Shuning uchun DAIni faqat mexanik shikastga xos belgi deb bo‘lmaydi. Natijani shikast taqsimoti va boshqa dalillar bilan birga baholash kerak.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Transport halokatida odam boshiga zarbadan 3 soat o‘tib vafot etdi. Aksonal shikastni qaysi usul eng erta ko‘rsata oladi?
options: Gematoksilin-eozin bilan oddiy bo‘yash usuli
β-APP ga qarshi immunogistokimyo usuli
Kumush bilan impregnatsiya qilish usuli
Faqat miyani makroskopik ko‘zdan kechirish
mcq.explanation: β-APP (β-amiloid prekursor oqsil) ga qarshi antitanalar shikastlangan aksonlarni jarohatdan 2–3 soat o‘tib aniqlaydi. Gematoksilin-eozin taxminan 24 soatdan keyin, kumush impregnatsiyasi 12–18 soatdan keyin shikastni ko‘rsatadi. Shuning uchun qisqa omon qolishda β-APP afzal.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

mcq.question: Likvorda >6000 ng/ml qiymat faqat TBI o‘limlarida kuzatilgan, nazorat guruhlarida uchramagan. Bu qaysi biomarker?
options: NSE — neyronga xos enolaza
S100B — kalsiy bog‘lovchi oqsil
GFAP — glial fibrillyar oqsil
BDNF — miya neyrotrofik omili
mcq.explanation: Likvorda NSE >6000 ng/ml faqat TBI o‘limlarida topilgan, nazorat o‘limlarida (ko‘krak qafasi izolyatsiyalangan travmasi, miya qon aylanishi yetishmovchiligi, to‘satdan tabiiy o‘lim) topilmagan. Mualliflar buni 100% xoslikka ega, ammo sezgirligi past bo‘lgan “ekstremal” chegara namunasi sifatida keltiradi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

mcq.question: Ekspert o‘likda likvor ferritini 30,0 mg/l dan yuqori ekanini topdi. TBI dan keyin eng kamida qancha omon qolgan deyish mumkin?
options: Kamida 20 daqiqa omon qolgan
Kamida 15 daqiqa omon qolgan
Kamida 3 sutka omon qolgan
Kamida 2 soat omon qolgan
mcq.explanation: Likvorda ferritin >30,0 mg/l faqat TBI dan keyin kamida 2 soat omon qolganda kuzatilgan. 20 daqiqa S100B ga, 15 daqiqa NSE ga, 3 sutka esa IL-6 ning >100 000 pg/ml qiymatiga tegishli minimal muddatlardir.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

mcq.question: Boshda tashqi shikast belgisi yo‘q, ammo likvorda biomarker chegaradan yuqori. Qanday xulosa to‘g‘ri?
options: Topilma TBI ni mustaqil ravishda to‘liq isbotlaydi
Topilma TBI ni butunlay inkor etishga asos bo‘ladi
Topilma shubhani boshqa topilmalar bilan birga kuchaytiradi
Topilma o‘lim vaqtini aniq soatgacha belgilab beradi
mcq.explanation: Hozirgi biomarkerlarning birortasi TBI uchun xos emas, ko‘rsatkichlar nazorat guruhlari bilan qisman ustma-ust tushadi. Chegara qiymatlar shubhani boshqa o‘limdan keyingi topilmalar bilan birga qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi, uni mustaqil isbotlamaydi. O‘limdan keyingi vaqtni baholashda ham biomarkerlar foyda bermaydi.

source.author: Zwirner et al.
source.title: Forensic biomarkers of lethal traumatic brain injury, International Journal of Legal Medicine

mcq.question: Og‘ir TBI bemorida KT da diffuz aksonal shikast aniq ko‘rinmadi, hushsizlik davom etmoqda. Qaysi tekshiruv mayda qon quyilishlarni sezgirroq topadi?
options: SWI yoki T2*GRE ketma-ketlikli MRT usuli
Shu KT tekshiruvini bir necha marta qaytarish
Qon zardobida faqat NSE miqdorini o‘lchash
Bosh suyagining oddiy rentgenografiyasini olish
mcq.explanation: KT diffuz aksonal shikastni yaxshi ajratmaydi va uni kam baholaydi. MRT esa DAI ni aniqlashda sezgirroq. Qonga sezgir SWI va T2*GRE ketma-ketliklari oqsil to‘qimadagi mayda mikroqon quyilishlarni tasdiqlaydi.

source.author: Frati et al.
source.title: Diffuse Axonal Injury and Oxidative Stress: A Comprehensive Review, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

extras.text: Eslab qolish usuli (Adams bo‘yicha diffuz aksonal shikastlanish, DAI, darajalari): 1-daraja – yarim sharlar oq moddasi, 2-daraja – qadoqsimon tana o‘chog‘i, 3-daraja – miya ustunining rostral qismi. Raqam oshgan sari shikast “pastga” tushadi.
